title: Re-study firstmate work handling and rebuild the explainer page
summary: Re-study firstmate's work handling at the pinned commit, adding the missed behaviors (teardown reopening a backlog item, yolo self-merge of green work, only a recorded PR or cleanup freeing a place with relaunches and secondmates uncounted) plus anything else found, then regenerate the explainer page from the study files.

defaults_applied.how: Every new claim cites a path and quote from the pinned source.
Page text is written for an outside newcomer.
Quotes validated by the kept test and the page rebuilt and inspected.
Re-study the whole work-handling topic for completeness, not only the three named gaps.

assumptions: Audience: the independent reader and newcomers who read the explainer page against the pinned firstmate source.
The pinned source is mounted for the producer (pin.json says pinned-source/); I could not read it, so exact additional gaps are unknown.
The rebuilt page is generated by xtask/src/site.rs from the study JSON; the output location may be committed or built by CI, so the output path is uncertain.
Pin stays at sha 6407052f; no re-pin.

acceptance_criteria.text: studies/firstmate-work-handling claims state, with citations to the pinned source, that teardown can reopen a backlog item instead of closing it.
Claims state that with yolo on, firstmate merges green work itself, and that only a recorded PR or cleanup frees a place, with relaunches and secondmates never counted.
Run `cargo test` from the root: the study rules test (crates/athena-cap-study/src/rules.rs) and xtask site tests pass, so every new quote and path validates against the pin.
Run `cargo run -p xtask` with the site subcommand (check xtask usage first), then `git diff --stat`: the rebuilt page contains the new facts and every sentence traces to a claim.
A reader checking the page against the pinned source (sha 6407052f) finds the three named omissions covered and no statement contradicting the source.

out_of_scope: Changing Athena's study capability code beyond what the page rebuild needs
Studying firstmate areas other than work handling
departures: Study jobs re-reading a whole source with citations and quote validation cost more than the typical change.
